(293)༄༅/ /phyag rgya chen po'i bogs 'don gsol 'debs rdo rje 'chang chung ma'i dmigs rim bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: (293)༄༅// phyag rgya chen po'i bogs 'don gsol 'debs rdo rje 'chang chung ma'i dmigs rim bzhugs so//

(294)༄༅// na mo ma hā mu drā ya/ phyag rgya chen po'i khrid dang lung gi rigs// mang du thob cing gnas 'gyu srung phyogs shes// de la mos 'dun che phyir ma brjed tsam// rgyun du bskyangs kyang bogs skyed ci yang med// yun ring song nas 'khreb ste bsgyur nyen che// de la bogs 'don gdams ngag gal che bas// phyag rgya chen po zer ba'i ye shes de// gsar rnying rgyud sde kun nas rgya cher gsungs// rgya bod grub chen thams cad gshegs pa'i lam// 'gran med nyi zla lta bur yongs su grags// de ni shes rab che bas go ba min// gzhung lugs rgya cher shes kyang de mi rtogs// rig pa'i gnas lngar mkhas kyang de mi shes// 'dod pa chen po byas kyang phan pa med// de nyid ma rtogs rtogs par bya ba dang*// 'phel ba de nyid brtan pa thob pa'i thabs// bla ma'i mos gus ma gtogs gcig kyang med// gsang sngags byin rlabs lam zhes bya ba ste// byin rlabs 'jug thabs mos gus las gzhan med// mos gus gsol ba 'debs pa kho na ste// mos gus gsol ba 'debs pa'i lam (295)zhes bya// gsol ba 'debs yul gang rung mi chog ste// brkos phor ri mo sāts+tsha dod pa ltar// phyag rgya chen por bka' babs bla ma dgos// deng sang gang zag tshig brgyud bla ma las// phyag chen khrid dang lung rnams thob phyin nas// gsol ba don brgyud bla mar 'debs chog ste// dwags po dus mkhyen rgod tshang pa rnams kyi// ma 'ongs phyag chen khrid lung thob phyir nas// khong rnams rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung mdzod la// gsol ba thob dang byin gyis rlob pa dang*// nyams rtogs skye zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa yin// de phyir mos gus bsgom gyi mgo bo yin// grub mtha' so so'i 'dod gtam mi gcig kyang*// pad+ma dkar dang ting 'dzin rgyal po sogs// mdo sna gsum nas mnyam med dwags po 'di// stong nyid ting 'dzin ston pa'i skyes chen du// thub pas lung bstan gsal phyir 'khrul pa med// de bzhin dus mkhyen drug pa seng ge'i sgra// thub pa u rgyan gnyis ka'i lung bstan gsal// phyag chen rgya gzhung bod du mang 'gyur kyang*// grub pa thob pa ha cang mang ba min// (296)phyag chen la brten dwags po lha rje'i rgyud// grub thob gnam gyi skar ma las kyang mang*// de phyir bka' bab byin rlabs tshan kha che// mar pas mi la ras par lung bstan nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar// nyams dang rtogs pa'i brgyud pa mi 'chad gsungs// de phyir brgyud pa'i byin rlabs yal rgyu med// de phyir sems rtsa ma zhum spro ba bskyed// mos gus sgom gyi mgo bor gsungs pa bzhin// dmigs pa 'di sgoms gsol 'debs 'di nyid kyis// rang nyid yi dam lha'am tha mal pa'i// spyi gtsug khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la// sna tshogs pad ma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng*// drin thob bla ma de dang dbyer med pa'i// chos rje dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa ni// sku mdog sngo skya bsgres tshul dbu skra dkar// dge slong cha lugs zhwa nag gser mdongs can// de yi dbu gtsug dwags po lha rje ni// bsgres tshul dbu skra dkar zhing dgas zhu gsol// de steng rje btsun mi la ras chen ni// sngo skya dbu skra phor ka ling nge ba// sku la dar dkar na bza' gsol ba'o// de steng mar pa sku mdog dmar smug la// dbu skra ral pa ag tshom bcas pa ste// ral gu smug po ber phyam dmar po can// de steng nā ro sku mdog smug nag dang*// de steng tai lo sku mdog mthing ga gnyis// thor tshugs rus rgyan grub thob cha lugs can// de steng rdo rje 'chang chen sku mdog mthing*// rdor dril thugs kar bsnol zhing longs spyod rdzogs// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mtha' skor thams cad du// phag gru dwags po sgom tshul 'ba' ram pa// skyob pa thang pa gling ras rgya ras dang*// skye med zhang dang chos rje g.ya' bzang ba// rgyal ba rgod tshang pa dang yang dgon pa// mkha' spyod dbang po grub chen rma se dang*// sangs rgyas dbon po ngom pa mkha' (297)spyod pa// tsher lung kun dga' rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen por mnga' brnyes pa'i// bka' brgyud bla ma khrom tshogs bzhin du bsgom// thams cad phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag spyan zim me// sangs rgyas zhing khams rab 'byams thams cad nas// bsgoms pa lta bu yid kyis spyan drangs bstim// rdo rje 'chang chen tai lo nā ro dang*// mar pa mi la chos rje sgam po pa// dus gsum shes bya kun mkhyen karma pa// che bzhi chung brgyad brgyud pa 'dzin rnams dang*// 'bri stag tshal gsum dpal ldan 'brug pa sogs// zab lam phyag rgya che la mnga' brnyes pa'i// mnyam med 'gro mgon dwags po bka' brgyud la// gsol ba 'debs so bka' brgyud bla ma rnams// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// zhen log sgom gyi rkang par gsungs pa bzhin// zas nor kun la chags zhen med pa dang*// tshe 'di'i gdos thag chod pa'i sgom chen la// rnyed bkur zhen pa med par byin gyis rlobs// mos gus sgom gyi mgo bor gsungs pa bzhin// man ngag gter sgo 'byed pa'i bla ma la// rgyun du gsol ba 'debs pa'i sgom chen la// bcos min mos gus skye bar byin gyis rlobs// yengs med sgom gyi dngos gzhir gsungs pa bzhin// gang shar rtog pa'i ngo bo so ma de// ma bcos de kar 'jog pa'i sgom chen la// bsgom bya'i blo dang bral bar byin gyis rlobs// rnam rtog ngo bo chos skur gsungs pa bzhin// ci yang ma yin cir yang 'char ba la// ma 'gags rol par 'char ba'i sgom chen la// 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// sogs brjod/

zhes pa'ang ban sgar 'jam dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'o// de ltar gsol ba (298)btab pa'i dus su yang*// dmigs pa rtse gcig dad 'dun drag po yis// bla ma rgyang 'bod tshul du gsol ba btab// gsol ba khyi skad ma ru gdab gsungs pas// bslab pa'i gyer dbyangs legs po mi shes kyang*// rnal 'byor rang gdangs gang shes gyer dbyangs bya// gsol ba 'debs dus bla ma'i mos gus kyis// ba spu g.yo zhing mchi ma 'khrugs pa dang*// yus kyis mnang nas ci drag gang drag gi /nyams 'bar 'khrab cing rgyug mchong bla mar 'bod// de ni mos gus sgom gyi mgo bo yin// de nas spyi bo'i bla ma thams cad ni// 'od zhu gtso bo dus gsum mkhyen par thim// dus gsum mkhyen pa 'od zhu bdag la thim// bka' brgyud bla ma de rnams sku gsung thugs// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du// chu nang 'o ma blugs bzhin 'dres par bsgom// de nas gang shar sems kyi ngo bo blta// ci ltar shar yang bzo bcos ma byed par// ma bcos de gar ma yengs tsam du skyong*// yag 'dod nyes su dogs pa rtsad nas spang*// mos gus stobs kyis skyes pa'i nyams rtogs la// gegs dang gom pa gcig kyang yod ma yin// rnam rtog 'phro rgod sban sbun ci byung yang*// chu dang chu rlabs bzang ngan med pa ltar// gnas dang bde dang gsal bas legs rgyu med// 'phro rgod sban sbun byung yang zhen rgyu med// ye nas sems nyid chos sku rjen pa yin// ngo shes ma yengs dran rdzis bskyangs pas chog /gang shar do lta rang grol la sogs pa// dang po yin gyis rgyun du de mi dgos// ma yengs dran pa'i rgyang so gcig pus chog /de ni yengs med sgom gyi dngos gzhi yin/ ༈ /tshe 'dir mi rtag rlung gseb mar me 'dra// mnga' thang longs spyod yod kyang 'khyer dbang med// mthun grogs 'khor 'bangs mang (299)yang khrid dbang med// de phyir sems la chags zhen 'khri ba bcad// zas nor longs spyod bsnyen bskur la sogs pa// bzang po chen po byung yang chags 'dzin spangs// sbyin bdag byang chub thob phyir bsngo smon bya// shugs kyis byung na ched du sdang mi dgos// dge phyogs gang 'grub rang lus dkyil 'khor mchod// yod kyang zas mi za ba'i dka' thub dang*// ngo srung med ces kun dang 'khon pa'ang spangs// 'phral du 'jig rten mi dang blo bstun kyang*// don la lha mi 'khor ba'i bde skyid 'di// mi 'tshengs phan chung gnod pa che bar bsam// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'dis skrag nas// phyir mi ldog par bde chen zhing khams su// 'gro ba'i thabs la ci drag gang drag bya// des ni rigs drug 'khor bar zhen pa log

/zhen log sgom gyi rkang pa de rang yin// phyi ma mi lus bde skyid smon lam 'debs// de 'dra zhen pa log pa ga la yin// mos gus mgo dang yengs med lus po dang*// zhen log sgom gyi rkang pa tshang ba na// sgom gyi mgo rkang tshang bas 'dod don 'grub// de gsum gcig ma tshang yang don mi 'grub// bogs skyed med pa de gsum ma tshang rtags// dwags po bka' brgyud lugs kyi phyag chen gyi// don gyi gnad 'gags gsol 'debs 'di la tshang*// zhwa nag cod pan 'dzin pa drug pa yi// sras kyi thu bo 'jam dpal bzang po de// gnyan chen thang lha'i ri mgul phug pa'i nang*// lo grangs bco brgyad mtshams bsdams mdzad pa yin// de phyir gsol 'debs 'di nyid byin rlabs che// bka' brgyud spyi yi gsol 'debs 'thus kyang che// dmigs pa gsal zhing gsol 'debs 'di byas na// nyams rtogs bogs skyed 'ong bar the tshom med// de yang mos gus drag (300)po bskyed gal che// rā ga a s+yas grwa pa spyi rnams la// phan pa'i bsam pas thun skabs shig la smras// sgom chen pad+ma mthar phyin zhes pas bris// 'dis ni gzhan phan rgya cher 'byung bar shog// /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
